videos.title: 환율 1,500원이라 주가가 폭락한다고요? 고환율 외국인 매도 진짜이유
videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, around 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences capturing the key points.
Key points from the transcript:
1. Common misconception: People think high exchange rate (1500 won) causes foreigners to sell stocks, leading to price drops.
2. Reality: The causation is reversed. Foreigners selling stocks causes the exchange rate to rise (they sell won to buy dollars after selling stocks).
3. Foreigners don't want to sell when won is weak (exchange rate high) because they lose money on exchange rate differences.
4. Real reason for selling: Global passive funds have automatic rebalancing rules. Korean stocks (especially Samsung, SK Hynix) rose too much (3x since April last year), increasing Korea's weight in portfolios beyond target levels.
5. So passive funds mechanically sell Korean stocks to rebalance, not because they hate Korea or think it's failing.
